description: This file contains the implementation of the SiloHealthMonitor class, which is responsible for monitoring the health of individual remote silos within the Orleans distributed runtime. It manages periodic probing (both direct and indirect) to assess silo availability and health. The class uses timers, logging, and cancellation tokens to perform asynchronous health checks and report results.

classes.name: SiloHealthMonitor
classes.description: A class that monitors the health of a specific remote silo, performing periodic probes directly or via intermediaries, and evaluates the silo's availability based on probe responses.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the health monitoring loop by starting the internal Run task.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the monitoring, waiting for ongoing probes to complete.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Immediately cancels monitoring and disposes internal resources.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes internal resources after stopping the monitor.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main loop that performs periodic health probes to the target silo and processes the results.

methods.name: ProbeDirectly
methods.description: Performs a direct health probe (ping) to the target silo.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Performs an indirect probe via an intermediary silo.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Checks if the health monitor considers the silo healthy based on the last probe and internal timers.
